title: S2 reset, restart and observer predicates with T03-T08 sound and broken fixtures
objective: Implement reset (erase forbidden past, preserve declared allowed state), restart equivalence and relevant-trace observer equivalence as separate predicates over the finite world, with sound and broken fixtures for T03-T08.
problem: Plan s4: T03 clean reset PASS + allowed-state preservation PASS; T04 display-only erase with a later-arriving forbidden packet -> reset FAIL even if the immediate buffer looks clean; T05 indiscriminate wipe -> preservation FAIL; T06 complete restart PASS, twin omitting queue/counter state FAIL, neither alone establishes reset; T07 observer alters then heals before score -> relevant-trace FAIL, declared irrelevant bookkeeping twin PASS; T08 repeated-boundary and split-channel leaks within the registered model -> reset FAIL (repeated calls and interacting shares, not one episode). Every C3 IN-MODEL known escape becomes a broken fixture that must now be caught. Verdicts are gate outcomes with reasons in the C1 shape.
non_goals: Do not copy code, tests or verdict policies from the Fable or ASTRA harnesses; they are reference and adversarial corpora (SOURCES.md B; NEXT_ROUND_PLAN_v0.4 s1)
Python >= 3.8 standard library only; no package installation (MWO-0004 R2)
Never weaken a registered case to pass (rso-builder-role s2.3)
evidence_required: RED: each T03-T08 broken fixture shown passing a deliberately naive predicate stub (the fire test, s2.4)
GREEN: every sound fixture accepted and every broken fixture rejected with the contract's reason
each C3 IN-MODEL escape present as a named fixture

acceptance.condition: T03-T08 sound accept, broken reject with expected reasons; C3 IN-MODEL escapes caught

authority: operator directive 2026-10-03 s9, s11 (roles/Achilles/prompts/2026-10-03_rso_builder_cell/01_OPERATOR_DIRECTIVE_verbatim.md); decomposed by Palamedes under C-004-T000
